units: <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 1">Lam. R. to I, 7</cite> <he>מדכרא … דמ׳</he> she remembers the seven days of her wedding feast.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 3">Gen. R. s. 3</cite> <he>כן וכן אנא מפקד … דמִישְׁתּוּתִי</he> this is my order for my wedding feast.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sheviit 4:8:4">Y. Shebi. IV, end, 35ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 11:2">Lev. R. s. 11</cite>, beg., v. <cite ref="Q01668"><he>פְּרוֹטוֹגַמְיָא</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Kohelet Rabbah 3:2:3">Koh. R. to III, 2</cite> <he>במִשְׁתּוּתֵיה</he> at his wedding.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 6:5:4">Y. Ber. VI, 10ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>למִישְׁתִּיתֵיה וכ׳</he> to the wedding at &c.; a. e.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁתְּוָותָא</he>.
